findings.location: Product card price (e.g., '£51.77') and availability status ('In stock') text
findings.issue: The bright green text color used for product prices and 'In stock' indicators on a solid white background fails to meet the WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast ratio threshold for normal body text.
findings.user_impact: Users with low vision, color blindness, or those viewing the screen in high-ambient-light conditions will struggle to read essential transaction details like price and availability.
findings.recommendation: Change the green text color from its current bright shade to a darker green (e.g., #2b5e2d or #1e4620) to guarantee a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against the white background.

findings.issue: The list items in the vertical sidebar menu (e.g., 'Travel', 'Mystery', 'Historical Fiction') retain browser-default bullet points. Standard vertical sidebar menus should avoid list bullets as they add visual noise and look unpolished.
findings.user_impact: The default bullets clutter the list layout, disrupting clean left alignment and making the text harder to quickly scan.
findings.recommendation: Set 'list-style-type: none;' on the sidebar navigation list container 'ul' element, and adjust the padding-left of the 'li' elements to 10px-15px for clean, un-bulleted vertical alignment.

findings.location: Product titles below star ratings (e.g., 'A Light in the ...')
findings.issue: Book titles are prematurely truncated with an ellipsis ('...') on a single line, even though there is sufficient vertical space below them to wrap text without overlapping the price.
findings.user_impact: Users cannot read the full name of truncated books directly from the catalog grid, forcing them to guess or click through to the product page just to read the title.
findings.recommendation: Remove single-line truncation and allow titles to wrap to a maximum of two lines using 'display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;'. Set a fixed 'min-height: 40px' on the title wrapper to keep the grid cards vertically aligned.
